parameters: \bAll life needs the sea to live, even\nthough it makes its home on the land.
\bLife, having run its course, becomes\nsoil and returns to the land.
\bAnd the sea is always connected to\nthe land.
\bAhh… It feels great letting the waves\nwash over my feet…
\bSpeaking of the waves, you know that\nisland city Sootopolis?
\bI think the Gym there had a new\nLeader come in.
\bPeople tell me the new Leader once\nmentored Wallace.
\bI'd heard Mossdeep's Gym Leader is\npretty strong, so I decided to come\ntake a look-see for myself.
\bPeople are going on about a warning\nletter and the Space Center…
\bI don't think it concerns me in any\nway, though.
\bI got this from Steven, but I don't\nknow what it's good for.
\bI think it's called King's Rock.\nDo you want it?
\bYou can keep it, but keep it a secret\nfrom Steven.
\bYeah, you think so, too! What are you\nsupposed to do with some weird rock?
\bA voyage on a ship is fine.
\bBut crossing the sea with POKéMON\nusing Surf…
\bNow that's an exhilarating trip!\nWouldn't you agree, youngster?
\rThe island's Space Center has been\nlaunching huge rockets.
\rThere's been some kind of an uproar\nover a letter they received recently.
\rThe island's Space Center has been\nlaunching huge rockets.
\rIf the whole world was covered in\nplants and flowers like this island?
\bI heard from a sailor buddy that\nTeam Aqua set up shop in Lilycove.
\bI also heard that someone came along\nand wiped the floor with them!
\bBut Mossdeep here's been targeted\nby that Team Magma.
\bIf you want to know what they're up to,\ngo visit the Space Center.
\bI'm a sailor, so the sea's obviously\nmore important to me.
\bBut you know? When I get back on land\nafter a long voyage, I do feel relief!
\rThis rock has a special meaning to\nthe people at the Space Center.
\rThey put it here as their wish for\ntheir rockets to fly safely.
\rWhen you make a wish, what do you use?\nDo you wish upon a star?
\rI use a wish tag to make it happen.\nThat's what I do.
